scope: Phone modules that the 7.3 module set deliberately omits or renames, with reasons

sdhci_msm.reason: AVR sdhci@8804000 (only SDHC) is status=disabled in the phone DT; the 7.3 in-tree sdhci-msm imports the upstream 7.3 qcom_ice API, which cannot coexist with the vendor ICE (ports/qcom-ice) that UFS FBE uses (same symbol names, different ABI)

debug_symbol.reason: debug_symbol_available()/debug_symbol_lookup_name() are provided by the 7.3 kernel (kernel/kallsyms.c, core commit 3684f35f1, verified by the debug-symbol suite) from the running symbol table instead of re-decoding the 6.12 debug_kinfo layout

pinctrl-canoe.reason: other-SoC variant loaded on the phone but bound to no device (checked /sys/bus/platform/drivers on the running AVR 6.12 ROM, 2026-11-17); the AVR binds the alor/canoe variant instead, which is ported (pinctrl-alor)

pinctrl-chora.reason: other-SoC variant loaded on the phone but bound to no device (checked /sys/bus/platform/drivers on the running AVR 6.12 ROM, 2026-11-17); the AVR binds the alor/canoe variant instead, which is ported (pinctrl-alor)

pinctrl-ravelin.reason: other-SoC variant loaded on the phone but bound to no device (checked /sys/bus/platform/drivers on the running AVR 6.12 ROM, 2026-11-17); the AVR binds the alor/canoe variant instead, which is ported (pinctrl-alor)

ext4_inode_test.reason: GKI KUnit test module (ext4 inode tests), not a device driver

lib_test.reason: GKI test module, not a device driver

clk_scmi.reason: 7.3 in-tree driver replaces the stale vendor copy

rproc_qcom_common.reason: same vendor sources (qcom_common.c + tracepoints); module name to be aligned at packaging

pwrseq_core.reason: 7.3 GKI builds the power-sequencing core in

first_stage_status.note: every phone first-stage module is ported, renamed (renamed{}), or deliberately omitted (omitted{}) with a reason

glink_probe.reason: phone soc:qcom,glink node has no children (edges are remoteproc glink-edge subnodes started by rproc_qcom_common); needs vendor qcom_glink_smem_start/spss APIs - revisit with SPSS

qcom_glink_spss.reason: SPSS (secure processor) edge transport needs vendor qcom_glink_native_start; ported together with qcom_spss

hwmon.config: HWMON (vendor adds devm_hwmon_device_unregister export: add to core if a ported user needs it)

phy_generic.config: NOP_USB_XCEIV (vendor diff: of_property_read_bool vs present only)

i2c_qcom_geni.config: I2C_QCOM_GENI (identical; unbound on the phone, vendor i2c-msm-geni used)

qcom_glink, qcom_glink_smem, smp2p.reason: 7.3-native sources without the vendor IPC log calls; logging only

qcom_q6v5_pas.reason: 7.3-native PAS with Alor descriptor; vendor PAS collects ramdumps via qcom_ramdump - pending remoteproc vendor-parity review

qrng_dlkm.reason: crypto RNG core is a module on 7.3 (CONFIG_CRYPTO_DRBG=m); built in on the phone

msm_sysstats.reason: uses the 7.3 is_dma_buf_file() instead of qcom_is_dma_buf_file() (equivalent identification)

msm_memshare.reason: native 7.3 glink never negotiates zero-copy, so qcom_glink_mem_entry_init/free are local no-ops (same as the vendor header !RPMSG_QCOM_GLINK branch)

gunyah_trace.reason: gunyah_get_info is built into the 6.12 GKI vmlinux; on 7.3 it is exported by ports/gunyah-core gunyah.ko

not_ported_inert.reason: AVR DT has no SPSS remoteproc node; the driver binds nothing on the phone (/sys/bus/platform/drivers/qcom_spss empty)
only used by qcom_spss/glink_probe for the SPSS edge, absent on AVR; needs vendor qcom_glink_native_start (7.3 native glink transport is used instead)
phone /soc/qcom,glink has no edge children; all remoteproc edges are glink-edge subnodes handled by native qcom_glink_smem via rproc_qcom_common
no qcom,qbt-handler node in the AVR DT; /sys/bus/platform/drivers/qbt_handler binds nothing (fingerprint is goodix_fod_mmi/anc_fps_mmi, both ported)
listed in vendor_dlkm modules.load but blocklisted (vendor_dlkm modules.blocklist); never loaded
test module, blocklisted on the phone
test module, blocklisted on the phone
PCIe WLAN platform driver; AVR WLAN (WCN7750) uses icnss2 (ported, wlan-platform); cnss2 is not loaded on the phone
hybridswap zram replacement loaded by init.mmi.overlay.rc; not loaded on the running phone (zram is built into the Rakkashin Image, which the 7.3 production config mirrors with CONFIG_ZRAM=y)
system_dlkm GKI module for Samsung Exynos hypervisor; no such hardware
system_dlkm GKI module for the MediaTek GenieZone hypervisor; loaded but inert on Qualcomm (no geniezone node)
7.3 port uses the C binder (Stage103, Android RT priority inheritance); rust_binder unused
